correctness.rationale: Assuming published Janasz Theorem B(3) for D_(3,5): rank-two local logarithmic derivations require 16 generators against ambient rank 15. For any five-column J, its rank<=2 locus in 3xn matrices is irreducible of codimension (3-2)(5-2)=3. On a dense open, all other maximal minors are units, so the divisor germ is precisely the five-column arrangement times 3(n-5) smooth coordinates; Nakayama implies minimal generator number 16+3(n-5)=3n+1. Closedness of the coherent sheaf nonfree locus extends inclusion to all Z_J. A six-column explicit integer matrix independently has precisely its ten five-column minors zero, all mixed minors nonzero; the construction confirms full rank for n>=6. No independent recomputation of the external 16-generator source theorem is claimed.
